text:
Anna: Heads-up I opened PR to tidy up Stratus6B and Glimmer-1.5B model cards: limits, embedding units, and an example for streaming + embeddings. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812. Need SME review on bench numbers and an SDK snippet for v3.

Rick: Quick scan 1: The Glimmer embedding table is missing "tokens/s" units and the example shows `max_tokens` but our field is `max_output_tokens` elsewhere. We should normalize naming.

Tiya: Also, Stratus6B card mentions "int8-quant" but doesn't call out that on runtimes < 2.5.1 you must set `quant_mode: compat` to avoid OOM during compilation. Suggest a one-liner compatibility note.

docsbot: PR #812 created by anna 1 docs-lint: passed, bench-ci: pending, link-check: passed.

Ben: I can own the SDK snippet. Will add Python (sync + stream) and a tiny Go example using our client v3. Will include a short note about fallback to stratus6b-lite when batch>8 triggers latency policy.

Ollie: Bench update 1 ran Stratus6B on a g5.12x with seq=1024 batch=8. Median tokens/s = 2,450; 95p = 2,000. Old docs showed 3,100 from a batched colab test. I'll upload CSV and update numbers if we want the g5 numbers. Link: https://internal-storage/redwood/bench/stratus6b/2026-03-21.csv

Anna: Let's call out per-infra numbers: Hosted (g5.x) vs Dedicated (p4d) and link the CSVs. I added a new subsection "Bench environment & notes".

Rick: For naming consistency: replace `max_tokens` with `max_output_tokens` in Glimmer examples and add a short migration note for SDK v2 -> v3 fields.

Tiya: Proposed compat wording: "Note: For runtime versions prior to 2.5.1, use `quant_mode: compat` or the `stratus6b-no-opt` variant to avoid compilation memory spikes. Upgrading runtime resolves this." Sound OK?

Ben: Pushed SDK commit. Python snippet:
```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client()
resp = cli.generate(model="glimmer-1.5b", prompt="Summarize the doc")
for chunk in resp.stream():
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```
Go snippet (v3):
```go
import "github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-go"
client := redwood.NewClient(nil)
res, _ := client.Generate(context.Background(), redwood.GenerateParams{Model: "stratus6b", Prompt: "Explain KV"})
fmt.Println(res.Text)
```
Also added a short note linking to migration guide.

Ollie: CSV uploaded and bench-ci passed. I updated the doc numbers to the median for g5.12x and left the p4d numbers in a fenced "Dedicated" block.

Anna: Nice. I also fixed a couple of stale links in the Glimmer card (old SDK2 migration link). docsbot said link-check passed earlier but we had one redirect; cleaned it up.

Rick: LGTM from my side. One tiny nit: embed throughput table should say "embeddings/sec" not "embeddings/s" to match other pages.

Tiya: LGTM. Added your compat sentence word-for-word.

Ben: All tests pass locally for the snippet. I included a comment showing how to detect `latency_policy` and choose `stratus6b-lite` automatically.

Anna: OK merging in ~10m unless anyone objects. Will post a short note to #release-war-room and ping infra to update runtime routing rules for the `quant_mode` flag.

Rick: No objections. :rocket:

Ollie: Merged. CI shows nightly deploy scheduled.
